messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, jack.todd@acme.com
Cc:
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Performance stitch: July dashboard, QBR prep & action owners

Hi team — attaching the July performance dashboard and a short latency appendix. This is the readout I'll use to brief execs in the QBR; posting here for visibility and to lock in owners for the follow-ups before Thursday's prep sync.

Top-line bullet summary:
- Latency: 95th p90 up ~18% month-over-month; largest contributor appears to be live streaming tails on hosted API (endpoint: text-gen-stream-v2).
- Cost: per-request token cost up 12% due to longer context windows and cache miss rate rising to 28%.
- Uptime: SLA met (99.95) but we saw two short infra-induced reconverges on 7/21 that added to tail latencies.
- Usage: Enterprise usage steady; a single large customer (Acme) increased burst profile and is on the callouts below.

Asks / proposed owners:
1) Latency deep-dive (Marcus) — provide root-cause candidate list + quick wins by EOD Wed (8/11).
2) Caching / batching policy tweaks (Evelyn) — propose a draft change and small A/B to test for the next two weeks.
3) QBR deck (Laura) — can you own collating final charts and an impact slide? Need first cut by 8/12 COB.
4) Customer note (Jack) — looped in so we can coordinate expectations; will follow up w/ suggested mitigations this week.

Attachments: [Attachment: monthly_dashboard_July2027.pdf (PDF, 1.6 MB)], [Attachment: latency_appendix_July2027.csv (CSV, 420 KB)]

I propose a 30-minute working session on Wed 8/11 09:00 PT to align slides and action sequencing. Meeting link in the Drive doc below. If owners above disagree on scope, reply inline.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700

Thanks Mina — grabbing this. I'll take the latency deep-dive. Initial notes:
- I see a sustained increase in KV cache misses for text-gen-stream-v2 starting 7/15 (matches appendix).
- There are a few kernel fallback events on older GPU pool (dedicated-legacy-3) around 7/21.

Action plan (short):
• Collect per-endpoint p50/p90/p99 by hour for 7/01-7/31 (I'll push the raw CSV to the Drive folder by EOD Tue).
• Check dedicated-legacy-3 for recent driver/kernel updates and patch schedule; will coordinate with infra.

Question for Evelyn: do we have a quick path to adjust streaming batch size without a full rollout? If so, I can test a narrow rollout on a canary pool.

Will post the CSV + short RCA by 08/11 17:00 PT.

—Marcus
Senior Product Engineer, Inference Runtime

Good notes — I'm on batching/caching. Quick replies to Marcus' questions:
- We can change streaming batch thresholds in the routing layer without a full runtime redeploy; it would be a config push + small canary (15% traffic) to validate.
- I'll prepare a small A/B: reduce max-stream-batch by 20% and enable a tighter cache TTL for prefix caching. Expect initial telemetry in ~36 hrs.

I've dropped a short proposal in the Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-monthly-dashboard (see file: batching_proposal_aug10.md). Marcus — can you include the per-endpoint CSV there so I can pick canary endpoints?

Also flagging Dedicated pool capacity: if the canary shows lower throughput we may need to temporarily shift some traffic to dedicated-hot to keep latency SLOs. Marcus — can you shadow capacity impact?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Inference Operations
Redwood Inference
